newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Zhenye makes rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Zhenye makes rights offer.

text.p: China property developer Shenzhen Zhenye Co Ltd said on Thursday it would make a three-for-10 rights offer at 12 yuan per share.

Zhenye has set a March 27 deadline for registering the rights offer, and the company's A shares would go ex-rights the following day, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times. It said it has appointed Shenzhen J&A Securities Co as chief underwriter.
Analysts said the issue was aggressively priced because Zhenye's stocks were trading at 15.87 yuan per share, up 1.05 yuan, at 11.05 a.m. (0305 GMT).
"J&A must be very confident about Zhenye's future," Song Bin, analyst at Central-South Securities Co, told Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
A spokesman for J&A said it set the price at this level because Zhenye needed the expected 480 million yuan rights proceeds to buy land and other property companies.
"If investors looked at where the proceeds are going, they would know the company has bright prospects," J&A spokesman Chen Jintang told China Securities Bulletin.
Zhenye said it would channel the funds into residential projects and the acquisition of two property firms.
Zhenye has 135.62 million outstanding shares made up of 51.23 million legal person shares -- or shares held by government-related institutions, and 84.39 million A shares, the statement said.
Zhenye reported net profit of 70.32 million yuan for 1996, up 55.09 percent from 45.34 million yuan the previous year, on strong sales of its property projects in Shenzhen.
